summary: Your homepage promotes dermatology, aesthetics and surgery, but the menu is mostly dead and a patient has no easy way to book or call.

findings.problem: Botox, Rhinoplasty and the other service menu items link to #.
findings.cost: A patient who taps the treatment she came for lands nowhere and leaves.
findings.fix: Working treatment pages, one per service.

findings.problem: No phone number or WhatsApp on the page. Booking is only a link to /appointments/.
findings.cost: Qatar patients expect WhatsApp, and every missing channel loses enquiries.
findings.fix: Click to call, WhatsApp and a short form on every page.

findings.problem: No reviews, no before and after, no named doctors. Images are generic icons, not your clinic.
findings.cost: Surgery and aesthetic patients choose on proof and who treats them.
findings.fix: Doctor profiles, real photos and captioned results.

findings.problem: The menu repeats, brand is Centre and Center, the About text shows stray symbols, and the email icon goes to follow.it.
findings.cost: Small slips on a medical site make patients doubt the care.

redesign: Working service pages with a book now button on each.
Phone, WhatsApp and a form on every page, plus doctor profiles and results.
